items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.

ctx.x: Did you go to, I think it was a green high school with James Rivers? I think you were like a year or two ahead of him. I think an Art Neville and James Black.

Not green school, I don't think. I registered for a green school one year. I think it was when it was, well, I don't know what was going on during that period, but it was some sort of transitional period going on. And I registered, but I didn't go to that school green. So I didn't get that. James Rivers and I went to Booker T together.

Were there a lot of other musicians that, well, a lot of other people who have gone on to be great New Orleans musicians there at the time, attracted by the marching band? A few, a few, I'd say, but not super, super lucky with me. Was one of your first gigs playing with Shirley and Lee on the road alternating with Huey Smith?
